mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle contraction regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces near-term corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 during late-cycle contraction, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening expectation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, triggering negative equity market reactions and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% simultaneously, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1600) signals a peak in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1600 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
